subject: Request to preserve sandbox while procurement completes
messages:
From: Tara Bloom <tara@silverline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 16 Nov 2024 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: preserve Silverline sandbox while procurement completes

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team was really impressed with how fast Redwood spun up inference for our use case. I wanted to be transparent: we've hit a vendor onboarding freeze with our procurement team while they complete an additional security checklist. The procurement folks say PO issuance will be delayed by 10–14 business days while they validate vendor questionnaires and run vendor risk assessments.

We have an internal pilot kickoff scheduled the week after next and we'd lose momentum if the sandbox times out. Could Redwood extend our active sandbox/demo environment while procurement closes out? Ideally we'd like a 10 business-day runway extension and, if possible, a small temporary token top-up so our ML engineers can complete the integration tests that require heavier token usage.

I attached a one-page snapshot of procurement's status (procurement-status.pdf) and the security questionnaire we've already returned (security-questionnaire-filled.pdf). If you need a procurement contact, loop in procurement@silverline.com — they're aware of the hold.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer here. We really want to keep the POC momentum going.

Warmly,
Tara Bloom
Head of AI Operations
Silverline Health

---
Attachments:
- procurement-status.pdf (pdf)
- security-questionnaire-filled.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.inference>
To: Tara Bloom <tara@silverline.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.inference
Date: Sun, 17 Nov 2024 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: preserve Silverline sandbox while procurement completes

Hi Tara — thanks for the transparency and for sending the questionnaire. I reviewed the procurement snapshot and the security questionnaire; appreciate you getting those over quickly.

We can absolutely keep the sandbox available while procurement finalizes. Our standard self-serve policy allows a one-time 7-calendar-day extension for stalls, but given the enterprise nature of Silverline and the depth of the integration work, I'm happy to escalate for an additional runway.

Immediate next steps I can do right now:
- Provision a 7-calendar-day extension to the sandbox (no action needed from your side).
- Hold a discretionary temporary token top-up (we can offer a 50k-token credit) subject to manager sign-off.

Can you confirm the preferred procurement contact and the expected PO ETA? Also, do you want us to sign any additional vendor docs (we already returned the security questionnaire but happy to supply additional evidence if procurement requires it).

I'll open this for internal approval for an extra runway + token top-up. If approved, I'll confirm via this thread and update your HubSpot record so CS and Finance are aligned.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.coole@redwood.inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.coole@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 18 Nov 2024 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request: Silverline — 10-business-day runway + 100k token courtesy?

Ben / Grace,

Heads-up: Silverline Health (SL-2024-0921) hit a procurement freeze — they returned our security questionnaire but procurement won't issue a PO for ~10 business days. The POC and a scheduled pilot kickoff will be impacted and the prospect asked for a 10 business-day extension plus a temporary token top-up to finish integration tests.

I've already provisioned our standard 7-day extension; request here is to approve a one-time exception:
- Extend sandbox by an additional 10 business days (total runway = 17 calendar days from today)
- Grant a 100k token promotional credit (one-time) to complete heavier integration tests

Rationale:
- Silverline is a mid-enterprise prospect in healthtech with clear near-term expansion potential (pilot -> paid deployment in Q1).
- They shared completed security questionnaire and have active technical engagement; losing momentum risks losing their slot with an internal procurement champion who is engaged.
- The ask is time-bound and we can mark the credit as non-recurring and attach an expiration.

If you prefer a smaller credit, we could do 50k tokens + a 14-day runway. My recommendation is to approve the 100k/10-business-day ask to preserve momentum and avoid re-onboarding friction. This is a low-dollar, high-leverage move.

Please reply with Approve / Decline / Counter. If approved, I'll confirm with Tara and update HubSpot (link below).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
Deal: SL-2024-0921

Thanks,
Marissa

---

Date: Wed, 20 Nov 2024 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: Silverline — 10-business-day runway + 100k token courtesy?

Approve.

I agree with Marissa's assessment — this is a keep-warm action to protect a high-probability mid-enterprise opportunity. Approve the following one-time concessions:
- 10 business day sandbox extension beyond the standard 7-day (total runway ~17 calendar days)
- 100,000 token promotional credit scoped to the SL-2024-0921 deal; credit expires 30 days after issuance and is non-renewable

Marissa: please confirm the extension in-thread to Tara, update HubSpot, and flag Finance & CS for reconciliation and to apply the credit against the deal. Tag me on the HubSpot activity.

Ben Carter
